The '''Frunchettan system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Frunchettan-sai]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> It lay outside the borders of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Frunchettan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-6.<ref name="TEA" />
